frame: Clamp frame: origin on the spine tube axis at the clamp's lower end; +X toward the skeleton's front, +Y its left, +Z up. The enclosure hangs behind the tube (-X).
status: Concept for review; geometry checks only. Fasteners and clearances are print hypotheses.

clamp.note: U around the tube's back and sides; a front bar with 4 x M3 x 25 screws into captured nuts squeezes the tube

channel.note: Female dovetail on the enclosure: slides down over the clamp's tongue and rests on its top; an M3 pin below the tongue stops it lifting

case.note: Pi long axis vertical with the USB end up; open side faces back

pca9685.note: Adafruit 815 layout on the wing beside the GPIO edge: control header at the bottom near the I2C pins, servo connectors facing out
